cells.gaps: No source found says AI is in service in the public systems of two or more sectors; the education dropout-prediction module and the ANAM forecasting work are pilots.
cells.note: The TB programme's CAD4TB has read X-rays in field campaigns since 2024, so AI is in service in health. Rung 4 needs AI in service in a second sector, and the May 2026 KIX-SEEDS dropout module is a pilot in two communes, so the measured TB results cannot lift the cell.
